## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any relevant roadmap item.

## Validation

List checks run and any checks that could not run. Distinguish fixture evidence from live provider evidence.

- [ ] Reviewed the diff for secrets, personal information, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] Updated relevant docs and reviewed any SQL migration.
- [ ] Ran `pnpm check` and checks appropriate to this change.

Use synthetic or redacted examples. Report security vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
